# Lab 27.3: CI/CD for SQL

## What We Are Going to Do
Build a Cloud Build pipeline that checks SQL with dry runs and compiles Dataform on every change, before anything reaches production.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Create a small repo with SQL files.**

<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH

<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">mkdir -p sql_cicd/sql &amp;&amp; cd sql_cicd
cat &gt; sql/daily_revenue.sql &lt;&lt;'EOF'
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS day, SUM(sale_price) AS revenue
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items`
GROUP BY day
EOF
cat &gt; sql/broken.sql &lt;&lt;'EOF'
SELECT day, SUM(revenue FROM sales
EOF</span>
</code></pre>

2. **[CLI] Write the build steps.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">cat &gt; cloudbuild.yaml &lt;&lt;'EOF'
steps:
- id: dry-run-all-sql
  name: gcr.io/google.com/cloudsdktool/cloud-sdk
  entrypoint: bash
  args:
  - -c
  - |
    set -e
    for f in sql/*.sql; do
      echo "Checking $f"
      bq query --use_legacy_sql=false --dry_run "$(cat $f)"
    done
- id: max-bytes-guard
  name: gcr.io/google.com/cloudsdktool/cloud-sdk
  entrypoint: bash
  args:
  - -c
  - |
    bq query --use_legacy_sql=false --dry_run --format=json "$(cat sql/daily_revenue.sql)" \
      | python3 -c "import sys,json; b=int(json.load(sys.stdin)['statistics']['totalBytesProcessed']); print(b); sys.exit(1 if b &gt; 50*1024**3 else 0)"
EOF</span>
</code></pre>
</div>

gcloud builds submit --config=cloudbuild.yaml .</span>
</code></pre>

   The build fails on `broken.sql`. Delete that file and run again: it passes.

4. **[Console] Connect to Git.** In **Cloud Build → Triggers**, create a trigger on pull requests to your GitHub repo, so every PR runs these checks. For Dataform, add a step that runs `dataform compile`; for dbt, `dbt build --target ci`.

5. **Discuss the flow.** Developer branch → pull request → CI checks (dry run, compile, tests) → merge → release configuration deploys to production (Lab 8.7).

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Dry run | Catches syntax and permission errors, free |
| Bytes guard | Blocks queries that are too expensive |
| Trigger | Runs on every pull request |
| Deploy | Only after checks pass |
